name: ai.decalabs/deca
title: DECA Labs
description: Demand signals, product ideas and real-ad demand tests for AI agents. Free to read.

tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: Today's demand patterns from DECA's radar: groups of apps climbing the App Store and Google Play charts, with what people say and want about them and the public posts behind it. Every chart fact names its store category and country. Free. Updated daily.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the pattern, its apps or what people say. Optional.

heat.description: Only patterns people are talking about this much. Optional.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

tools.name: get_ideas
tools.description: Consumer product ideas DECA's engine wrote from the demand signals and judged worth testing, best first, each with the apps and posts it rests on and its expected sign-up rate. Ideas another founder is testing are not shown. Pass id to read one idea. Free.

id.description: One idea's id, to read only that idea. Optional.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the idea. Optional.

verdict.description: Only ideas the judge rated this way. Optional.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

tools.name: check_idea
tools.description: Any product idea, checked against today's app-store charts and against what DECA's own products measured. The idea is placed by meaning next to the apps climbing the charts; back come facts with sources, not an opinion: the closest apps and where they rank, the demand pattern they belong to and its heat, what their users complain about, what people search for that nobody answers, how crowded the field is. Free.

name.description: The product's name, if it has one.

pitch.description: Who it is for and what it does for them, in a few sentences.

tools.name: get_benchmarks
tools.description: The rates a DECA demand test is priced on: what a click from paid social costs in each market we test in, and what a page for an unbuilt product turns into confirmed sign-ups. Free.

tools.name: get_my_ideas
tools.description: The ideas DECA's engine wrote for your own workspace from what it knows about you (set in the dashboard under Settings → Your radar), each with why it is yours, and the day's public ideas it picked for you. Needs an API key; a key sees only its own workspace. Read only: it never asks the engine to write more. Free.

include.description: Ideas written for you, the day's picks for you, or both. Default both.

limit.description: How many of each to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

tools.name: quote_test
tools.description: The price of testing an idea with ten days of real ads, before anything is paid. One payment in USDC on Base: a $29 launch fee for the idea (DECA makes the brand, the landing page, the ads and a film, runs them and reads the result; no subscription) plus the ad budget you pick, at cost. Each option's total_usd is what start_test charges. The budget is sized to the idea: several options (signal, clear read, market comparison, or your own budget), each with its expected visits, the number of confirmed sign-ups it must reach to pass, and what it can and cannot tell. Use an idea_id from get_ideas or describe your own idea. The quote is valid for 30 minutes. Free; nothing is charged.

idea.description: Your own idea, when it is not from get_ideas. It is never published.

pitch.description: Who it is for and what it does for them, in a few sentences.

markets.description: Where the ads run. Default: US, GB, CA.

budget_usd.description: A budget of your own to price alongside the options, between 250 and 2000. Optional.

tools.name: start_test
tools.description: Pay for one option of a quote and open the test. The price is the option's ad budget in USDC on Base, paid over x402. Call it first without `payment`: the answer is an x402 payment request for the exact amount. Pay it with an x402 client and call again with the payment as `payment` (the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value). A person reviews every test before its ads run; a declined test is refunded in full. Use sandbox: true to try the whole flow on Base Sepolia with test USDC; a sandbox test runs no ads and moves through its states in minutes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id from quote_test. Quotes hold for 30 minutes.

option.description: Which of the quote's options to pay for. Default signal.

payment.description: The x402 payment, base64, as an x402 client creates it. Leave out to get the payment request.

idempotency_key.description: Any string. Sending the same one again returns the same test and never charges twice.

webhook_url.description: A public https address told of every change, signed with the webhook_secret returned once.

sandbox.description: Base Sepolia and test USDC; no ads run. Default false.

tools.name: get_test
tools.description: A paid test's state and everything in it: payment, review, the pass line, progress and the result. Readable with the key it was paid with, or its access_token.

access_token.description: The access_token start_test returned, when the test was paid without a key.

tools.name: list_my_tests
tools.description: Every test paid with this API key's workspace, newest first. Needs a key.

tools.name: cancel_test
tools.description: Cancel a test that is still in review, before its ads run. The whole budget is refunded to the paying wallet.

access_token.description: Needed when the test was paid without a key.
